# @glastor/core

> The resilient, high-throughput core engine powering next-generation distributed systems.

## Quick Overview
- Version: 0.1.0
- License: Apache-2.0
- Runtime: Deno >= 2.0.0
- Entrypoint: ./src/mod.ts

## Public API Reference
- `GlastorConfig` (interface) - GLASTOR Core Engine configuration options.
- `KernelStatus` (interface) - Kernel status representation.
- `initGlastorCore(config: GlastorConfig): KernelStatus` - Initializes and starts the GLASTOR Core engine.
  - Example: ````ts import { initGlastorCore } from "@glastor/core"; const status = initGlastorCore({ appId: "glastor-edge", debug: true }); console.log(`Engine healthy: ${status.healthy}`); ````

## Documentation & Links
- Repository: https://github.com/glastor-core/glastor-core
- Documentation: ./book/
